value.rationale: Natural Ising antiferromagnet on the canonical antiprism/cycle-square family. A complete finite-size parity ground-state and correlation classification resolves a physically motivated frustration boundary, gives a zero-field Curie coefficient, and exhibits a nonuniform macroscopic-separation correlation limit. Not merely a parameter substitution, isolated numerical recomputation, or generic transfer-matrix identity.
